name: Horse Guards Parade
text: Horse Guards Parade is a large parade ground off Whitehall in central London (at grid reference TQ299800). It is the site of the annual ceremonies of Trooping the Colour, which commemorates the monarch's official birthday, and the Beating Retreat.

depictions.name: Horse Guards
depictions.text: Horse Guards (building) The Horse Guards is a military building in Westminster in London, England, housing the Household Cavalry Mounted Regiment, the squadron that makes up the monarchy's Life Guard.
